title: Per-token AI charges come to GitHub Copilot
summary: GitHub Copilot is transitioning from a flat-rate subscription model to a per-token pricing structure starting June 1st, 2026, replacing the current system that provided a set number of 'Premium Requests' with more granular usage-based billing.
problem_solved: Addresses the need for more flexible, usage-based pricing for AI coding assistance tools instead of fixed monthly subscriptions.
why_valuable: Provides developers with more cost-effective options by allowing them to pay only for what they use rather than a fixed monthly fee.
